title: Shimon ben Avtolmus
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Batra 68a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.68a.7), explaining what "sanṭer" (סנטר) means; Hyman infers that he is an Amora of the Land of Israel ("Yerushalmi"). Dikdukei Soferim reads "ben Avshalom."[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The linked Bava Batra gives Shimon ben Avtolmus’s explanation as the fields around the city. The preceding interpretation gives a land registrar.
[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3486&lang=en) also records ben Avtolmus. Hyman attributes ben Avshalom to Dikdukei Soferim.
Hyman infers that he was an Amora of the Land of Israel. Yerushalmi here is a regional description.
